children: ASIC HALTS OFFERS IN MORTGAGE SCHEMES MANAGED BY AUSTRALIAN SECURE CAPITAL FUND
INTERIM STOP ORDER STOPS ASCF FROM OFFERING, ISSUING, SELLING OR TRANSFERRING INTERESTS IN ASCF PREMIUM CAPITAL FUND, OTHERS
ASIC WILL CONSIDER MAKING FINAL ORDERS IF THE CONCERNS ARE NOT ADDRESSED IN A TIMELY MANNER.
ASCF WILL HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE SUBMISSIONS BEFORE A DECISION IS MADE ABOUT ANY FINAL STOP ORDERS
